{{Quote|The role of a warrior is to protect the Chiss people. The warrior's own survival is of only secondary importance.|[[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
The '''Chiss warriors''', also known as '''Chiss soldiers''',<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> '''Chiss troopers''',<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" /> '''Chiss bodyguards''',<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> or simply '''Chiss guards''',<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" /> were a core part of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. Their primary purpose was to serve as security, the Ascendancy's primary military force and enforcing the borders of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] territories.

==Overview==
Per the regulation standards for a Chiss soldier, the [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was supposed to be pulled severely back to the nape of a neck.<ref name="Force Heretic I: Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref> Unlike the [[Chiss officer/Legends|Chiss officers]], a pair of silver bars indicating the owner's [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] were absent on the collar of the [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]]'s uniform.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> Although, warriors assigned to [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] duty wore a uniform with a pair of silver bars, [[Vambrace/Legends|vambraces]], [[Epaulet/Legends|epaulets]], a military shoulder belt, and an [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]],<ref name="LECG" /> similar to the [[Defense Fleet uniform]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Chiss soldiers were equipped with [[maser]]-[[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. They were transported from [[Armored personnel carrier/Legends|armored carriers]]. They also utilized advanced [[fractal-pattern armor]] in battle.<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" />

==History==
With the [[New Order/Legends|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Chiss soldiers of Thrawn's household guard eventually [[Treason/Legends|defected]] to [[Empire of the Hand]] underneath the command of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], who was a Chiss [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Species/Legends|kind]].

They would notably see action during the [[Swarm War]], where they would be deployed during the [[Battle of Tenupe]].<ref name="Dark Nest III: The Swarm War" />
